why: The tests only assert that the live_preview configuration object is present in options, but never simulate a page request with live preview parameters or verify that draft content values are actually returned or rendered.
vc: When the page request includes live preview parameters, the rendered page displays the draft content values for the entry being previewed.

why: The tests only assert on the presence or absence of the live_preview property in the options object, never rendering a page or verifying that published content field values are present and accurate.
vc: When live preview is not active, the rendered page displays the correct published content for every entry — all field values are present and accurate.

why: The tests only assert Contentstack live preview SDK configuration options (management tokens, hosts, env flags) and never simulate an unauthenticated user attempting to access a protected page to verify content is blocked.
vc: For a page that requires authentication, an unauthenticated visitor cannot view the page's content.

why: The tests only assert the shape of the ContentStack configuration options object based on environment variables; none simulate an unauthenticated visitor, live preview parameters on a request, or assert that draft content is absent from a rendered page.
vc: For a page that requires authentication, draft content does not appear on the rendered page when live preview parameters are present and the visitor is unauthenticated.
